messages:
alex: Quick pre-weekend sweep — I’m handing off at 17:00 PT. Items I touched today: KV-cache eviction patch, ingress firewall tweak, and canary for model-variant routing. Leaving a few follow-ups below — please ping if you take them.

maya: thanks alex. quick q — did the KV patch fully roll to canary? any perf regressions in the 95th p50? :eyes:

alex: rolled to 10% canary around 13:40. No CPU spike on canary in grafana, p95 latency for text-gen steady at ~210ms. I left the canary at 10% to soak overnight.

samira: i can monitor overnight — taking handoff. i'll keep an eye on the canary metric dashboard and error budget alert.

jon: heads up — the postmortem item about "egress firewall stale rule" (PMT-17) was patched earlier today but we didn't update the runbook. alex can you drop the quick runbook line? otherwise we might reopen if someone follows old steps.

alex: good catch. added runbook note at the end of PR #2124: "If adding egress rules, run `rb-check egress --sync` and bump rule version in k8s secret." Also added a one-liner in the runbook: `egress-sync status` to verify. 

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled smoke tests at 01:00 UTC. Target group: dedicated-pool, canary 10%.

maya: samira thanks — two things I care about tonight: 1) PMT-23 (db connection-pool leak) — is there a fix rollout? 2) if the canary starts showing elevated 5xxs, fallback policy is to route to stable-2026-03-01, correct?

samira: PMT-23 — hotfix merged, deployed to staging and dedicated pool at 15:30. I can promote to prod if we hit issues, but current telemetry shows pool size normalized. Fallback: yes — routing policy in route-config v3 sends traffic to stable-2026-03-01 when canary error rate > 3%. I verified the rollback play in the console.

alex: one extra: if the canary needs to be scaled down manually, use `rctl rollout set canary=0` (needs infra-svc rights). I left a temporary escalation contact in the handoff doc: @samira -> @jon -> @maya.

jon: taking secondary on-call. i'll check the runbook patch later and confirm.

samira: thanks team — i'll watch 01:00 UTC smoke test and the canary dashboard. if anything spikes i'll open a thread and escalate. leaving status: all green, canary at 10%, KV-patch active, runbook updated. :white_check_mark:

alex: perfect — have a good weekend everyone. :slightly_smiling_face:
